description: Permanently delete a hosted video and its file. Irreversible: always confirm with the user first (name the video) and only then call with confirm set to true.

confirm.description: Must be true. Ask the user to confirm before calling; deletion is permanent and removes the file from Vidreno's storage.

video_id.description: The video's public id (from list_videos / get_video).

title: Delete video
